description: courtscheduler refused the booking or the call to it failed (LPT-2590). 'status' is courtscheduler's HTTP status, passed on as is: hearing does not interpret it. It is absent when courtscheduler never answered (connection refused, timeout). 'message' is courtscheduler's own text plus the HTTP status, for logs only - not user-facing and not translated. 'bookingId' is present only when the request carried one: a refused first pick has none. It is a plain string, not a uuid, so that an unexpected id can never make the framework drop this event for failing its schema.
